title: RegistryEntry
description: A single entry in the loader registry. Wraps either a Component, ComponentSet, or Item with a type discriminator and shared metadata.

type.description: Discriminator that tells the loader which schema to apply to 'data'.

data.description: The payload — must match the schema for the declared type.

source.description: File path or URI from which this entry was loaded. Injected by the loader; omit in authored files.

loadOrder.description: Relative load order. Lower values load first. Entries with equal loadOrder are processed in declaration order.

namespace.description: Optional namespace prefix. The loader exposes this entry as '<namespace>.<id>' when set.

deprecated.description: When true, the loader emits a deprecation warning on access but still loads the entry.

deprecatedMessage.description: Human-readable deprecation notice shown alongside the warning.

experimental.description: Marks the entry as experimental; the loader may gate this behind a feature flag.
